_about: Single source of truth for what counts as a match. Read by cl_watch.py, email_watch.py and Claude's hourly check. Edit here, not in the scripts.
must_have: real parking (garage, off-street, assigned; extra fee OK)
_reject_phrases: Exact phrases (lowercase). A post containing any is rejected by the scripts and by Claude.
_dealbreakers: Plain-English rules for Claude to judge (e.g. 'no units on Geary or Lombard'). Scripts can't check these; Claude's hourly check and report do.
